Security._comment: Development only: the SPA is served over plain http by Vite and proxies /api, so cookies cannot be Secure. Production keeps CookieSecure=true (appsettings.json).

LiveKit._comment: Local LiveKit (video-server/start-dev.ps1, loopback only). Keys come from user secrets (see README). WebhookListenUrl: plain-http loopback listener used ONLY for LiveKit webhooks (LiveKit cannot trust the dev certificate).

Email._comment: Localhost testing with REAL recipients (decided by the user on 1 Nov 2026): invitees receive the e-mails themselves. Links point to WebBaseUrl (localhost), so they only open on this laptop until LAN mode / hosting. To redirect all mail to one test inbox again, set RedirectAllTo and remove AllowRealRecipientsInDevelopment.

Recording._comment: Localhost: library and spool under <repo>/recording (git-ignored), the R2 recorder from its Release build, FFmpeg from C:/ffmpeg (change to your install).
